## Security checklist

Skills are instructions an agent runs with the installing user's permissions. Please confirm:

- [ ] No new hooks, MCP servers, scripts, or executables.
- [ ] No new network calls, URLs, or commands that download or run remote content.
- [ ] No weakened guardrails (asking before merging, no force-push, no bypassing protections).
- [ ] No hidden content (HTML comments, invisible characters, encoded text).
- [ ] Plugin `version` bumped if behavior changed.
